raw_tick_release.verification: release SHA256SUMS plus raw event-order audit

population.signal_admission: 2024 runtime logs must show signals equal opened, zero entry_blocked, zero order_send_failed, and zero runtime errors; 2023 signals are deterministically regenerated from the accepted M15 contract

result_layers.exploration_reproduction: exact 14-trade source identity gate; never used as binding portfolio rule
result_layers.direct_pre_raw_identity: strict-later direct instruction identity before exact 2024 tick disarm
result_layers.raw_tick_binding_events: binding changed-trade set after exact tick profit disarm and tick exit
result_layers.accepted_signal_portfolio_replay: binding result; baseline and candidate realized balance, realized drawdown, PF, concurrent positions, stack state, margin admission, reopened exposure capacity

historical_gates.fold_total: default portfolio delta > 0 in all four folds
historical_gates.severe: combined severe delta > 0 and at least three of four folds severe delta > 0
historical_gates.direction: combined Long and Short delta > 0; each direction nonnegative in at least three of four folds
historical_gates.winner_damage: Loser benefit > absolute Winner damage; combined top-decile retention >= 0.90; each-fold top-decile retention >= 0.85
historical_gates.breadth: delta excluding best date > 0; excluding best two dates > 0; no month contributes more than 50 percent of total improvement
historical_gates.trigger_breadth: at least one binding exit per fold; at least 10 total; at least 5 final Losers
historical_gates.reproduction: exact exploration 14/+202.1/Long65.2/Short136.9 and exact trade identity
historical_gates.tick_event_order: all pre-raw 2024 identities resolve as raw-confirmed candidates or explicit positive-P/L disarms; every retained candidate has valid entry, arming, reclaim, failure and exit chronology
historical_gates.portfolio_admission_identity: all accepted signals remain admitted; no baseline or candidate margin block; candidate creates no extra signal because source runtime admitted every detected signal
historical_gates.full_signal_admission: 2024 signals equal opened and no blocked/failed entry in both folds

cost_contract.default_2024: raw variable-spread Bid/Ask for candidate disarm and candidate exit

workflow.technical_rerun: same commit, inputs and workflow only

decision.research_fail: one or more historical gates false
decision.2025H1_unlock: Research pass plus MT4/TDS parity only
